name: Disneyland Ronto Roasters "Ronto Morning Wrap" (Eggs & Cheddar on Pita)
whyItWorks: Scrambled eggs, grilled pork sausage, and melted cheddar cheese wrapped in a warm soft pita bread. Soft, filling, and high in morning protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ronto Morning Wrap with light peppercorn sauce (or request no sauce for zero spice).
watchOuts: Request no peppercorn sauce if sensitive to black pepper
